title: feat(types): TooltipSchema.content is text only on both faces (objectui#10295)
body:
Closes #10295
Part of #7759
Clause-②: yes

## What

`TooltipSchema.content` is now **text only on both faces** (direction (i) of the card, the mechanical outcome of ruling 5617465269 rule 2).

- **TS face** (`packages/types/src/overlay.ts`): `content?: string`, with JSDoc stating the read and the `content`-wins precedence.
- **zod mirror** (`packages/types/src/zod/overlay.zod.ts`): `z.string(...)` with a named refusal. A non-string at `content` fails with `invalid_type` at path `content`, and the message names `children`. The spelling is the objectui#9511 string-narrowing precedent (`RECORD_ID_IS_A_STRING_GUIDANCE`), because this narrows an arm and does not retire a key. `retirementTombstone` and `aliasKeyRefusal` would refuse every value, including the string arm that renders.
- **Docs**: `tooltip.mdx` lists `children` in place of the retired `body` and corrects the prose that said the renderer "never" reads `children`. `slider.mdx` now shows `defaultValue?: number | number[]`, matching PR #10292.
- `tooltip.tsx` is **unchanged**, so the changeset is minor on `@object-ui/types` only and carries the BREAKING note.

## Premise re-verified

- **The spec does not declare a tooltip node.** I grepped for `TooltipSchema`, `z.literal('tooltip')` and `'tooltip'` in two places: the installed `@objectstack/spec@17.4.0` `src/`, and objectstack `origin/main` (`b81da66d`) `packages/spec/src`. The only hit is a field-help spelling test (`builtin-node-config.test.ts`). As a control, `layout: z.enum(['vertical'` hits `component.zod.ts` and `view.zod.ts` on the same ref.
- **The read site** is `{(schema.content || renderChildren(schema.children)) as any}` inside `TooltipContent`. `content` is placed raw, and only `children` goes through `renderChildren`.
- **I probed the crash with the real `SchemaRenderer` and registry** (a throwaway test, not committed):
  - `content: {type:'text', content:'NODECONTENT'}` renders `Component "tooltip" failed to render` / `Objects are not valid as a React child (found: object with keys {type, content})`.
  - A string at `content` renders.
  - A node under `children` renders.

## The `content || children` question (ruling 5617221514)

I measured the same probe with both keys authored.

- **Today, a non-empty `content` wins and `children` is silently not rendered.** `content: 'STR', children: NODE` renders only `STR`.
- An empty string falls through to `children`.

I did not change this in `tooltip.tsx`. Rule 2 makes the read site the truth: the precedence is the contract, and what was missing was a statement of it. It is now in the declaration's JSDoc, in `tooltip.mdx` and in the changeset. It is also pinned by the renderer test below. The remaining option is to refuse both-authored documents at the mirror. That would be a new validation rule, not a clarity change, so I am leaving it to the seat.

## Author corpus

I scanned `examples/`, `content/docs`, `skills/`, `apps/` and `packages/` for `type: 'tooltip'` nodes. The only authored tooltip, `basic-tooltip.json`, has string `content`, so nothing needed migrating. The only node-valued `content` was the objectui#10280 pin, and I triaged it:

- Its "still accepts every arm the declaration states" case pinned exactly the branch removed here, so I replaced it: it now accepts only the text arm and points at the new pin.
- Its list refusal still holds.

## Pins, and the reverse verification

- `packages/types/src/__tests__/tooltip-content-is-text-10295.test.ts` checks both faces:
  - Type level: `Equal` pins `TooltipSchema['content']` to `string | undefined`, and a `@ts-expect-error` covers a node at `content`.
  - Runtime: a node, a list and an inline locale map are each refused. For each, the test asserts `code` `invalid_type`, the path, the message's first sentence, and `under \`children\``.
  - Positive controls also pass: text at `content`, and a node or a list under `children`.
- `packages/components/src/__tests__/tooltip-content-read-10295.test.tsx` renders through the real `SchemaRenderer`. It checks that text renders, that `children` renders, and that when both are authored `content` wins and `children` is absent.
- Reverse verification. Both legs used `ablation-replace.mjs` on the committed fix, and both restored to blob == HEAD with an empty `git diff HEAD`:
  - TS face widened back to `string | SchemaNode`: `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` exits 2. The errors are TS2344 (`Equal` pin), TS2578 (unused `@ts-expect-error`), and TS2322 in `zod-mirror-parity.test.ts`, where the parity ledger also catches the divergence.
  - Mirror widened back to `SchemaNodeSchema`: vitest reports 3 failed / 40 passed, and the three refusal cases are red.
- Parity ledger: `WiderThanDeclared` had no tooltip row left to remove, because objectui#10280 emptied it. The two faces agree, and the parity test stays green.

## Gates

On the final head `80a8ca36f`, which includes the `origin/main` merge:
- `vitest run packages/types/` plus the tooltip renderer pin plus `overlay-trigger-mirror-6939`: 219 files / 4981 tests passed.
- `types` `type-check` (all three `tsc` legs) is green against the pinned `@objectstack/spec@17.4.0`.

Against spec built from objectstack `main` `b81da66d`:
- I injected it with `spec-main-shape-gate.mjs inject`. The script re-pointed zod to 4.6.1.
- `types` `type-check` and the three tooltip/parity test files (54 tests) are green.
- I then restored the pinned install, so every importer's zod link is back at 4.4.3.

Before the merge:
- I built the `@object-ui/components^...` closure (8 projects), and `components` `type-check` is green.
- `snapshot-critical`, `container-declaration-ratchet` and `check-component-surface-parity` tests: 5 files / 90 tests passed.

The main merge moved nothing under `packages/types`, `renderers/overlay` or `content/docs/components`.

Other checks:
- eslint `--no-inline-config` on the 5 changed `.ts`/`.tsx` files: 0 errors, 0 warnings, measured from `--format json`. `eslint.config.js` enables no type-aware linting, so this diff cannot change a verdict on an untouched file.
- Passing checks:
  - `check-changeset-presence`
  - `check-changeset-no-major`
  - `check:spec-symbols`
  - `check:new-line-citations` (0 new citations)
  - `check:doc-types`
  - `check:doc-fences`
  - `check:control-bytes`
  - `check:changeset-claims`
  - `check:pending-changeset-literals`
  - `check:component-surface-parity`
  - `check:designer-field-key-parity`
  - `check:test-path-roots`
- `check:doc-snippets` and `check:doc-examples` are **NOT MEASURED**. Both exit 2 with PREREQUISITE NOT MET because the 34-package build they need is missing, so they are left to CI. The two `.mdx` edits are inside `plaintext` fences.

## Acceptance notes

- `check-changeset-presence` counts `@object-ui/components` as touched because the new test lives under `packages/components/src/`. `tooltip.tsx` is unchanged, so the changeset names `@object-ui/types` only, as the dispatch specifies. The gate is green.
- `tooltip.tsx` still carries `as any` on the content expression. With `content` now `string`, the cast is no longer needed. I left it because this PR does not touch the file.
